units.translation: Since she sailed as a fitting destroyer of ships, destroyer of men, destroyer of cities.
Since Zeus made you a partner in the lustral waters.
Since who expected that this unexpected flight would land?
Since for what reason am I now in the power of the gods?

But when the dust has drawn up a man's blood, once he is dead there is no resurrection.

Since your report has confirmed this.
